name: Mandarin Oriental Lutetia Paris
positioning: Left Bank palace hotel in Saint-Germain-des-Prés, Paris, dating back to 1910
best_for: Travelers who want a base in Saint-Germain-des-Prés on the Left Bank
Guests who want Eiffel Tower views from their room or terrace
Guests who want a spa with a 17-metre indoor pool

facts.text: The hotel is located at 45 Boulevard Raspail, 75006 Paris, France.
The hotel has 184 rooms, including connecting and family rooms.
The Lutetia was founded in 1910 by the Boucicaut family.
The hotel reopened in May 2018 after a total restoration.
The restoration was led by architect Jean-Michel Wilmotte.
The Spa at Mandarin Oriental Lutetia is a 700 m² wellness space.
The hotel has a 17-metre indoor pool.
The hotel has on-site valet parking for guests.
Brasserie Lutetia is run by Executive Chef Patrick Charvet.
The hotel received the Triple Crown Awards 2026 from Condé Nast Traveler.

highlights.text: The Spa at Mandarin Oriental Lutetia was awarded Best Hotel Spa in France 2023 at the World Spa Awards.
Romanesque frescoes at Bar Josephine were rediscovered and restored.
Bathtubs carved out of a single block of marble are oversized by Paris standards, according to Condé Nast Traveler.

considerations.text: Condé Nast Traveler says the hotel is expensive.
Guests can reach the Eiffel Tower with a 15–20-minute taxi ride depending on traffic.
WhataHotel notes the historic building may have traditional room layouts.
